name: Color Splash by Gilmar Smith
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
Color Splash adds a gentle burst of vibrant saturation to each hue, enhancing your photos with a lively yet balanced look. This recipe is perfect for those seeking to infuse their images with brilliance and brightness without overwhelming the scene. A touch of warmth in the highlights creates a welcoming glow, while careful adjustments ensure skin tones remain natural. With Color Splash, your photos will radiate soft, vibrant energy, making every color pop just enough to capture attention, without overpowering the natural beauty of the image.
